meta.name: domain-name-brainstormer
meta.description: Generates creative domain name ideas for your project and checks availability across multiple TLDs (.com, .io, .dev, .ai, etc.). Saves hours of brainstorming and manual checking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成创意域名并检查可用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为项目寻找可用且创意的域名。
copy.tagline_en: Generate creative domain names for your project and check availability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for available and creative domain names for your project.

howto.what: 当你描述项目后，它会生成创意域名并检查 .com、.io、.dev 等后缀的可用性，同时提供品牌建议。
howto.when: 当你开始新项目、产品、个人品牌或需要为已有项目寻找替代域名时触发。

say.text: 帮我为远程团队的项目管理工具想几个域名。
say.note: 它会分析项目并生成可用域名列表。

say.text: 为我的AI写作助手找域名，偏好 .ai 或 .io 后缀。
say.note: 它会按偏好筛选并检查可用性。

howto.what_en: When you describe your project, it generates creative domain names and checks availability across TLDs like .com, .io, .dev, and provides branding insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, company, product, personal brand, or rebranding, or when finding alternatives for a taken domain.

say_en.text: Suggest domain names for a project management tool for remote teams.
say_en.note: It analyzes the project and lists available domains.

say_en.text: Find domain names for my AI writing assistant, prefer .ai or .io.
say_en.note: It filters by preference and checks availability.
